title: Aadhaar
description: Aadhaar is a 12-digit identity number issued by the Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI).
eligibility: Any resident of India, including children and newborns, can enrol for Aadhaar.
required_documents: Date of birth proof, where available
application_steps: Locate an authorised Aadhaar Enrolment Centre on the UIDAI website.
Submit the enrolment form and identity and address documents.
Complete biometric capture and receive the enrolment acknowledgement.
Download or receive Aadhaar after UIDAI verification.

title: PAN Card
description: A Permanent Account Number (PAN) is a ten-character alphanumeric identifier issued by the Income Tax Department.
eligibility: Indian citizens, companies, firms, trusts, and other entities that need a tax identifier can apply.
required_documents: Proof of date of birth for individuals
Recent photograph for an individual application
application_steps: Open the PAN application on the official portal.
Complete Form 49A for Indian applicants or Form 49AA for foreign applicants.
Upload or submit the required documents and photograph.
Pay the application fee and track the acknowledgement.

title: Passport
description: An Indian passport is an official travel document issued by the Ministry of External Affairs.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen can apply for a passport, subject to verification and applicable rules.
application_steps: Register on the Passport Seva portal.
Complete the fresh or reissue passport application.
Pay the fee and schedule an appointment at a Passport Seva Kendra.
Attend the appointment with original documents for verification.
Track delivery after police verification, where required.

title: Ayushman Bharat
description: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides eligible families access to cashless hospitalisation coverage at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Eligibility is based on the government beneficiary database and scheme rules; citizens can check their status through the official portal.
required_documents: Aadhaar or another accepted identity document
Ration card or family identification details, where applicable
application_steps: Check beneficiary eligibility on the official PM-JAY portal or through an authorised help desk.
Complete beneficiary verification with the required identity documents.
Receive or download the Ayushman card if eligible.
Use the card at an empanelled hospital for covered treatment.

title: PM Kisan
description: PM-KISAN is a central government income support scheme for eligible landholding farmer families.
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families are covered subject to the scheme exclusions and verification requirements.
required_documents: Land ownership or land record details
application_steps: Visit the official PM-KISAN portal and choose New Farmer Registration.
Enter Aadhaar and required personal and land details.
Submit the registration for verification by the relevant authorities.
Check application status and e-KYC status on the portal.

title: Driving License
description: A driving licence authorises a person to drive specified classes of motor vehicles in India.
eligibility: Applicants must meet the minimum age and other requirements for the relevant vehicle class.
application_steps: Apply for a learner licence through the Parivahan portal or local RTO.
Pass the learner licence test and practise for the required period.
Apply for the permanent licence and book a driving test.
Pass the driving test and complete the fee and document formalities.

title: Scholarship
description: The National Scholarship Portal brings together scholarship applications and payments for eligible students.
eligibility: Eligibility varies by scholarship and may depend on category, income, academic performance, course, and domicile.
required_documents: Caste or category certificate where applicable
application_steps: Create or update a student profile on the National Scholarship Portal.
Review scholarships matching your course and eligibility.
Complete the application and upload supporting documents.
Submit before the deadline and track institute and department verification.
